reason: The flagged text is the static subtitle of the Spend controls row. It is on the page before any save (it shows in the receipt-saved screenshot, where Spend controls was never saved). The save result is the Rule updated toast in a pre-existing role=alert container.
criterionAnalysis: 4.1.3 covers messages that report the success, result or progress of an action. Will override controls set for individual cards is the row's standing description, not a result of Save: it reads the same on cards.policy-receipt-saved, where Spend controls was not saved. The confirmation is the Rule updated toast, announced through the pre-existing role=alert toast-container (live=assertive). No other A or AA criterion covers static row text.
